record.title: Evaluate isolated control composition and evidence history
record.intent: Decide whether exact preserved primary evidence supports continuation without weakening inventory checks.
requirements: Independently assess original and derivative inventory history, exact cache cause, unchanged original control/source/primary artifacts, native-verified external control snapshot and narrowly changed composition. Require full inventories and explicit pins; no generic cache/STOP exemption. Close reasoned GO or HOLD for this offline remedy.

GO grants preparation only. Actual RF still requires independently accepted stable run/current ArmReady, concrete fresh A1 configuration and controller review, original-task reconciliation and the composition decision. Preserve 75 slots, all electrical/source/numerical conditions and hard deadline. No additional scope reset or contact during this task.
Commit and push the conclusion before the next experiment.
acceptance: A reasoned bounded preparation decision binds preserved evidence and remaining actual gates.
